book.name: SUMBAOGHA
book.title: Allahri Imap So'oap Sumbaogha Sembe Musari Mome Toro Pibog Yubu

content: Ishakti Yakubag, “Kanaan kelabo topsiseng kom,” aro ambarogha (28:1-5)
Ishak nenekori Yakub yobogti, Allah siag kibogti, ambarelamogti, “Name, andi Kanaan kelabo topsiseng kom!
Anin ili Betuelag Aram mog so'oag pimendi, anawang Laban elmangkelabo anabiagne nhon topsululam.
Allah Imap So'oap Saelbamlange nenekori an mikip nembagheleba, andi mangarobari mangaroba maikno taikti, nimi sisa nubu taukang.

NUNI Allahri Abraham o'ona senelamogti, yeplamog saog uro an anmaboap yeplamsileba, so'o an nimi yangkanne saog uro wamlamag ane Allahri Abrahamag, 'Anisag yabo tatsinun,' seogne sunsunum uro a'un ngai talulom,” aro ambarog.
“A'unin Ribka eldo Labanag Aram mog so'oag pululam,” aro ambarogne sunsunum uro Yakub neneko Aramne Betuel elme Laban wamoghag piog.
Esau nenekori elkel nhon ma'aropne tobogha (28:6-9)

Ishak nenekori elme Yakub Allah siag kibogti, “Kanaan kelabo topsin koma Aram mog so'oag pimendi, Aram kelabo el phululam,” aro ambarog. Yakub neneko ili ilindi leptekne ka'ebaogti, Aram mog so'oag piogne sembe Esau nenekori ka'ebaog.
Ka'ebaogti, sikini Ishak nenekori, “'Kanaan kelabo tohinne sembe karong', senen,” aro Esau el taogti,
Abraham elme Ismaelag piogti, elkelabo phende abeneko babe wamdekpa, nen wilindipne Ismael elmangkel Nebayot ilipsa'el Mhalat
tobog.
Yakub nenekori as Betel lenda mabogha (28:10-22)
Yakub neneko as Bersyeba laplobi agha, “As Kharan punun,” aro piog.
Palamog pahabog heng puruk aogpa, pioghag anekoa kirik nhon tobogti, kirik aneko agha usog epto malamog.
Malamogti lenda malamogpa, moromna nhon so'oag agha sekamogpa, imap tibamogpa, Allah ilipsabo malaikat moromna aneko toman kululung walelem alameka ipsiog.
Kemelamsiogpa, NUNI Allah moromna aneko toman sekamogti, “Anisag Abrahamap, ani Isakap, Sikini Allah Na ane wamna,” seogti, “Nari, 'So'o an malamlamag ane an, anmaboapti ngai taukang,' aro tatsinun.

Andi mangarobari mangkahyikne taneko so'o lenglenga alirop kom wamla saog uro taikpa, sikininge so'o heng walelingkirobag sip, heng purukul pirobag sip, ople sip, tabo sip maikno talul. Anap anmaboap pere agha Nari nimi sisa ni tala-tala wamikne walingena tatsinun.
As tala-tala pimenag Na anap wamnemeri yepto piangkenun. Nari an sae lipken koma wamne pahabog anag Nari lemnange ni ulamneri, mog so'o eneag samoro payakenun,” aro ambarog.
Wene alamog abeneko Yakub neneko pukogti, yubu lelamogti, “NUNI Allah tane wamlange weneog el tanel!” seogti,
nen yubu lelamogti, “Na wamnaag ane nimiri loghag. As tane Allahri ae wamlaba, imag yangkanne ina siramag wamna,” aro log sembaog.
Nen mabogti, lukun Yakub seklamogti, “Allah wamlaag ane,” aro, “Kekneba pimnun,” sembaogti, kirik usog epto mabog kirik eneko so'oag mebirogti, kirik anekoag kal saitun wangka lolteroba mag ikog.
Ikogti, samen mog so'o ene Lus engeroba aneko Betel
engkaog.
Engkaogti Yakub nenekori Allah whingag salag palilamogti, “NUNI Allah nanap nhon palamnemeri, terobap nanenge ag eneknangeap tarelamneleri, yeplamnele pahabog
wali uro naniri aeag samoro yane tanena, kekneba na sembe talul. Ni undo saog uro pinep tanena, 'El Allah aghabog nari ukuma wamlul,' aro omeklamnun.
Nia mangkina Eldi tarelamnelea taneko pogto sa'obare palu tobiagha, palu nhon nen samoro El tarelamnun. Kirik mebitnaag ane Allah wamlaag, Eldi ae saog uro talul,” seog.
